facts.statement: The study created a sensor that detects glutamate by turning its binding into an electrical signal without using enzymes.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The device combines a polydopamine recognition layer with a Prussian Blue transducer on a carbon fiber electrode.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The sensor works linearly for glutamate concentrations between 0.10 and 400 micromolar and can detect as little as 31 nanomolar.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Other substances caused less than 14% of the electrical response seen with 10 micromolar glutamate.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The sensor gave consistent readings when switching between 100 nanomolar and 1 micromolar glutamate and resisted buildup from proteins.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The device successfully tracked changing levels of glutamate release in a gel that mimics a brain hematoma.
facts.subject: computational
